title: Concept: pnpm lockfile resolves a package from a git repository
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a pnpm resolution that names a git repository instead of a registry tarball, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed code is outside registry publication controls, so no checksum or advisory range covers it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: The installed code is outside registry publication controls, so no checksum or advisory range covers it.
